title: Google’s The Selfish Ledger (leaked internal video)
summary: Leaked internal Google X video, 'The Selfish Ledger', a speculative thought experiment about treating user data as a ledger that could guide and shape human behavior, including products sold to fill data gaps.
why: HN cites it as a glimpse of how Google and other data companies think about behavioral sequencing and data collection.

quote.text: pushing specific products on relevant customers in order to fill gaps in data collection.
